Play fair. Enjoy the journey.

Game terms · 26 October 2026 · SpeedInno

Brick Breaker is a free game with optional cloud saves. Guest play does not require an account. Configured editions may offer optional finite autoplay time packs and voluntary rewarded advertisements. There are no cash prizes. Manual play and normal retries remain free.

Your account

Use an email address you control and keep sign-in codes private. Create an account only if you meet the applicable age and consent requirements. Do not access someone else's account, attack the service, automate excessive requests, or impersonate another player.

Stages and progress

The first twelve stages are available from the start. Complete all twelve to unlock the expanding journey; later stages unlock in order. Manual and assisted completions both advance the journey. Manual and clean-clear mastery are recorded separately. Published shared stages are versioned and are intended to remain stable. An expanding catalog does not mean a mathematical guarantee of infinitely distinct layouts.

Cloud saves synchronize completed stages and stage history. The current field is saved on the device; it is not a live cross-device simulation. Local storage can be lost when app data is cleared or the app is uninstalled. Keep an account and verify synchronization if you want cloud recovery.

Optional autoplay time

Autoplay uses the same gameplay and physics and does not guarantee a win. Starting an activation requires a connection. Only active real seconds count; pause, manual takeover, backgrounding, life loss or stage completion end the activation and unused authorized time is reconciled to your bank. Gameplay rewards are limited and shown in the time bank; imported and assisted results do not earn manual rewards.

Time packs are repeatable one-time purchases, not subscriptions. Checkout displays the store/provider price and exact duration. Sign in before checkout; verified time belongs to that game account and can be used across official editions. Recovery synchronizes its existing balance and does not replenish consumed purchases. Unused purchased time does not expire. Store approval, verification or network delays can leave a purchase pending; use Recover purchases or contact support rather than repeatedly checking out.

Refunds follow the applicable store/provider process and mandatory consumer rights. Identifiable unspent refunded time is removed without taking unrelated valid credit; already-consumed refunded time is recorded for review. Deleting your game account removes its time bank, including unused purchased time. Contact support before deletion if you need help with a purchase. Minimal transaction records remain after deletion to prevent duplicate grants and handle refunds.

Availability and changes

We aim to keep play and cloud saving reliable, but outages, bugs and updates can occur. We may correct faulty levels, improve the game, or suspend abusive accounts. Mandatory consumer rights in your region continue to apply. Nothing here promises uninterrupted service or removes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Data and deletion

The privacy notice explains storage and account data. You can delete your account from the game or the web deletion page.

Code and content

The original game code is available under the repository's MIT license. Dependency and font licenses continue to apply to their own files. Read bundled third-party notices. Reference videos, third-party game branding, and creator watermarks are not included in the game.

Support

Contact support for game problems.
